description: This Java source file defines the ResponderService class, which provides background messaging functionalities including processing incoming messages, maintaining chat history, and displaying notifications in an Android wearable chat app.

classes.name: ResponderService
classes.description: An Android Service that processes incoming messages, maintains chat conversation history, and displays notifications for a wearable chat application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up the responder, broadcast manager, and processes any incoming messages on startup.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used in this service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming intents, processes reply messages, or retrieves chat history.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification with the latest response.

methods.name: processIncoming
methods.description: Processes incoming text, generates a response, updates chat history, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: broadcastMessage
methods.description: Sends a broadcast message with the current chat line to update the UI.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the service is stopped.
